etale local rings over a DVR are discrete valuation rings (More on Algebra, Lemma more-algebra-lemma-Dedekind-etale-extension) and their completions are complete DVRs (More on Algebra, Lemma more-algebra-lemma-completion-dvr)

core_obligations: Prove that a morphism f : X -> Y of locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces which is representable by algebraic spaces, etale and surjective is rig-surjective
proof_roadmap: Given an adic p : Spf(R) -> Y with R a complete DVR, the base change Z = Spf(R) x_Y X -> Spf(R) is representable, etale and surjective, hence nonempty.
Choose a nonempty affine formal etale V -> Z; it corresponds to an etale ring map R -> A with V = Spf(A^wedge), and since A^wedge is nonzero there is a maximal ideal m of A over m_R.

The local ring A_m is a DVR by the etale-extension lemma, its completion R' is a complete DVR, and the morphism-between-formal-spectra lemma produces the adic lift Spf(R') -> V -> Z -> X, proving rig-surjectivity.
difficulty_reason: H3: a valuative-style reduction finding an etale DVR extension over a closed point and composing the formal lifts.
